containment: This was a zero-ID research infrastructure work unit. No outcome values were used, no alpha hypothesis or candidate was selected, no production ledger was created, and no broker call, order, position, policy, allocation, or trading permission changed.
accepted_nonblocking_limitations: No repository-external immutable append anchor or WORM store yet; coherent full-history rewriting requires an external anchor before any canonical claim.
Full-prefix validation, whole-file replacement, and cumulative registries have quadratic scaling pressure and require segmentation or checkpoints before full-market deployment.
A stale concurrent writer safely fails but does not yet receive a dedicated stale-manifest error taxonomy; it must rebuild from the winning manifest.
Atomic replacement is process-failure safe in tested cases but does not claim power-loss-level directory rename durability.
The ledger reconstructs the event input snapshot payload locally; a future shared helper should reduce maintenance drift risk.
